style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Artificial 2ft Christmas Pine Tree in Cement Pot
style.toneOfVoice: Bring festive cheer indoors with this 61cm Christmas pine tree, beautifully presented in a stylish cement pot. Expertly crafted with lush, green pine branches, this compact tree captures the natural charm of a real pine, offering a realistic and vibrant centerpiece for your seasonal décor. Perfectly sized for tabletops, sideboards, or small corners, this tree adds instant holiday spirit without taking up too much space. The sturdy cement pot provides a modern, neutral base that complements any interior style while keeping the tree stable and ready to display. Measuring 61cm in height, this artificial Christmas tree is maintenance-free, staying full and vibrant year after year. Ideal as a standalone decoration or dressed with mini baubles and lights, it brings effortless festive charm to your home with lasting appeal. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Pot Dims: H11xD11cm.
